relations.subject: Heinrich August Jäschke

relations.subject: Heinrich August Jäschke
relations.evidence: From 1856 director of the Herrnhutian missionary station at Kyelang in Lahaul, West-Himalaya. After quarrels with his fellow-workers, said to be founded on his excessive modesty, he resigned his post in 1863
